# SimpleSign

Pure .NET, Native-AOT-oriented digital-signature library for PAdES, CAdES and XAdES.
Targets .NET 8 and .NET 10, uses `System.Security.Cryptography`, and has no third-party
cryptographic dependency.

## Canonical signing API

All signing formats start with their format-qualified factory and use one shared ADeS profile:

```csharp
var profile = AdesBaselineProfile.LongTerm(
    new TimestampOptions(new Uri("https://tsa.example")),
    new LongTermValidationOptions());

var result = await PadesSigner.Document(pdfBytes)
    .WithCertificate(certificate, chain)
    .WithLevel(profile)
    .SignWithDetailsAsync();
```

Use `CadesSigner.Document(data)` and `XadesSigner.Document(xml)` for the other formats.
Configure diagnostics with `.WithLogger(logger)`, HTTP with `.WithHttpClientProvider(provider)`,
and external signing with `.WithExternalSigner(certificate, signer, chain)`. `IExternalSigner`
receives `ExternalSigningRequest`, including resolved PSS parameters when applicable.

`SignAsync` is strict. Best-effort enrichment requires `SignWithDetailsAsync` and an explicit
`SigningLevelFailureBehavior.ReturnLowerLevel` profile.

## Important constraints

- Timestamp endpoints must be absolute HTTP(S) URIs.
- RSA and ECDSA external signatures are verified before packaging; EdDSA signing is rejected.
- Unsupported XMLDSig archive transforms and topologies fail closed.
- CAdES does not expose a buffering stream facade; CAdES streaming is deferred.

## Repository guidance

- Build: `dotnet build SimpleSign.sln`
- Focused unit suite: `dotnet test tests/unit/SimpleSign.PAdES.Tests`
- Interop suite: `dotnet test tests/interop/SimpleSign.Interop.Tests`
- AOT smoke: `dotnet publish tests/smoke/SimpleSign.AotSmokeTest -r linux-x64 -f net10.0`

See `README.md`, `docs/conformance.md`, `docs/interoperability.md`, and migration guides for
supported topology details and release-specific breaking changes.
